title: Disclose GenAI on First Session
content: Disclose plainly that the person is interacting with generative AI and not a human. When the disclosure is due depends on the Utah provision: on a clear request in a consumer transaction (§13-75-103(1)); at the start of a high-risk interaction in a regulated occupation (§13-75-103(2)-(3)); and for a mental health chatbot, before a Utah user may access its features, at the beginning of an interaction if the user has not accessed it within the previous seven days, and any time the user asks or otherwise prompts it about whether AI is being used (§13-72a-203(2)). These anchored provisions do not require re-display at every session or after 30 minutes of inactivity; the statutory seven-day absence-of-access condition remains distinct.
